implementation: Original Go implementation of documented API contracts; no TypeScript source is copied.
reference_license: MIT; DEEPSEEK_LICENSE.txt retains the upstream notice
differences: Claude tool names and query/domain filters replace the DSH multi-query model schema.
Provider Markdown is processed by an existing tool-free child activation to honor the Claude WebFetch extraction prompt.
Explicit shared HTTP-attempt budget, no provider retries or redirects, sanitized errors, and bounded Unicode excerpts.
No fetch cache, provider-independent redirect handoff or Anthropic hosted search backend.
